references.text: Moses appoints judges over the people based on Jethro's advice, which is the background for the arrangement Moses refers to in Deuteronomy
The command to judge fairly and not show partiality in judgment
Parallel text about appointing judges who will judge the people with fair justice without accepting bribes
The command not to pervert justice for the foreigner (גֵּר), which is specifically mentioned in the verse
Jehoshaphat instructs the judges to judge fairly, in accordance with Moses' command
Job describes how he was like a father to the poor and investigated the case of those he did not know
Isaiah urges people to judge fairly and help the fatherless and the widow
Zechariah repeats the command to judge fairly and show mercy to widows, the fatherless, foreigners, and the poor
Jesus urges people to judge with fair justice and not by outward appearances
